data.name: Asaalat
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'as'alah' which means to ask, to request, or to beseech. This name is often given to girls as a reminder of the importance of prayer and supplication to Allah (swt). It is also a beautiful reminder of the peace and tranquility that comes from connecting with the divine.
